name: DS Cluster S10c: Upsample Fill Methods
description: Tests: upsample with FillMethod.ffill/bfill/nearest/asfreq on monthly CPI → daily.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10c: Upsample Fill Methods
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
cpi_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)().result

# === ALL upsample how= VARIANTS ===
up_ffill = upsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=FillMethod.ffill)(cpi_raw)
up_bfill = upsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=FillMethod.bfill)(cpi_raw)
up_nearest = upsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=FillMethod.nearest)(cpi_raw)
up_asfreq = upsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=FillMethod.asfreq)(cpi_raw)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="CPI Upsample: ffill vs bfill vs nearest",
    category="Upsample",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ffill", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="bfill", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="nearest", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(up_ffill, up_bfill, up_nearest))
